# telnyx_ai_mission (Resource)

An AI mission, a long-running task an AI agent carries out with its own model, instructions and tools.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_ai_mission" "example" {
  name           = "Weekly churn review"
  instructions   = "Review last week's cancelled accounts and summarise the reasons."
  execution_mode = "managed"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `execution_mode` (String) One of `external`, `managed`.
- `instructions` (String)
- `metadata` (String) A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `model` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_mission.example <mission_id>
```
